about: Per-piece fit of OPEN headwear (circlets, bands, crowns, a veil on a band). Generated by .local/rl-heads/scripts/headwear/fit_open_headwear.py; read by src/actors/rl_head/rl_headwear_fit.gd. fits[<sex>] / fits[<sex>/<hairstyle>] are for an actor with an RL head (bald / over that RL hairstyle); fits[<body>] / fits[<body>/<hairstyle file stem>] for a shipped head of a body listed in shippedBodies (an actor without an RL head); fits[<key>/*] is the fallback for other hair. The band rests on the skull plus the hair under-layer (capped lift), about level, forehead 2.5-3.5 cm over the brows, back never under the occipital bulge. Each fit is a model-space rest transform applied after the shipped socket placement: scale (aniso widens x and narrows z by sqrt(aniso)) and pitch about pivot, then offset; then warp: the distance of every vertex from warp.axis (through warp.origin) is multiplied by k(phi) = cos[0] + sum cos[m] cos(m phi) + sin[m-1] sin(m phi), phi in the band plane from the front (+Z) towards +X, faded out below the band over fadeBelow. trails[<sex>]: the rule that picks the hanging cloth (vertices below the band plane in components reaching minReach below it, weighted start..full, outside frontSector) and how long it stays (length, of its authored metric length; keepLengthSector keeps the fitted length in front).
shippedBodiesAbout: Shipped (non-RL) heads of these bodies take fits[<body>...] too. Other race bodies are left as shipped: their race heads and variants need fits of their own. RL_HEADWEAR_FIT=0 turns every fit off, =rl keeps only the RL-head fits.
